title: Finite intersection property for closed subsets of a compact space
statement: Place sets and index families in compatible universes as in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $X$ be a topological space such that every open covering of $X$ admits a finite subcover. Let $I$ be a set and let $(C_i)_{i\in I}$ be a family of closed subsets of $X$. Suppose that $\bigcap_{i\in F}C_i\ne\varnothing$ for every finite subset $F\subseteq I$, where the intersection for $F=\varnothing$ is $X$. Then $\bigcap_{i\in I}C_i\ne\varnothing$.
